real_run.human_task: 请根据上传文件 /mnt/user-data/uploads/synthetic.npz 建立单目标近红外回归模型。目标为 synthetic property，单位 a.u.，domain=default。请使用 llm_autonomous、sealed_holdout、autonomous_rounds=true、autonomous_delivery=true，完成初始方案选择、真实 Cal/Val 反馈决策、合适时停止、冻结、唯一 Test 和模型报告交付。预处理、模型、参数策略、每个后续动作和何时停止都由你根据实际证据自主决定，无固定模型或固定轮数要求。允许提前 STOP；不能根据 Test 继续优化。使用内部独立留出验证和 development 预算配置，task_budget 为以下 JSON：{"max_experiments": 3, "max_fits": 18, "max_decisions": 6, "max_wall_seconds": 180, "max_llm_calls": 18, "max_llm_tokens": 800000, "max_output_tokens": 3600, "max_invalid_decision_repairs": 2, "final_llm_calls": 6, "final_llm_tokens": 500000, "final_wall_seconds": 180}。Cal CV 使用3折，自主分配累计18fits。比较至少两个合理候选，只提交选中方案。错误需显式修正。STOP 和预算后 RETAIN 应按返回合同提供证据及保留实验。可以选择历史成功实验，程序不会替你选最小RMSE。最终使用返回的报告/模型链接，等待真实用户审批，不自动注册。保持提案简洁。

alternatives.comparison: PLS on SG-smoothed SNV spectra; smoothing targets high-frequency noise, SNV targets scatter, PLS handles 12 highly collinear wavelengths with few latent variables.
Ridge with L2 regularization on mean-centered raw spectra; internal scaler plus alpha sweep controls collinearity without latent-variable structure.
RBF-SVR on SNV spectra to allow smooth nonlinearity if the linear candidates underfit; internally scaled.

proposal.difference: Initial direction: smoothing+scatter correction before a compact linear PLS model, compared against raw-spectrum Ridge and nonlinear SVR alternatives.
proposal.expected_outcome: PLS on SG-smoothed SNV spectra selected over the grid by train-CV RMSE, with Cal CV and Val performance reported; the model should generalize to the 12-sample holdout without overfitting.
hypotheses: SG smoothing (window 7, order 2) plus SNV will reduce train-CV RMSE versus raw spectra by suppressing the flagged noise/scatter proxies.
A low PLS component count (1-3) will suffice given 12 collinear wavelengths and 36 samples.

not_selected_reasons.B_ridge_raw: Ridge on raw spectra retains scatter/baseline and noise that raise the effective noise floor; L2 alone may not suppress the 0.5 high-frequency noise flagged in the profile.
not_selected_reasons.C_svr_snv: Nonlinear kernel adds hyperparameter sensitivity with only 36 calibration samples; no evidence of nonlinearity yet, so defer as a later SWITCH_MODEL candidate if linear models underfit.

observations.claim: Calibration set has 36 samples, 12 wavelengths, regular axis, low signal-to-noise (high_frequency_noise_score~0.50) and scatter variation (~0.24), no spikes.
Governing protocol is sealed_holdout with 3-fold KFold CV on calibration, Test sealed until freeze; validation has 12 samples.
Runtime supports pls, ridge, svr, et with writable parameter keys; sg_smooth and derivative methods available for noise/scatter handling.
Budget allows up to 3 experiments and 18 fits; 3-fold CV means each candidate costs 4 fits.

proposal.rationale: The calibration profile flags high-frequency noise and scatter with only 12 wavelengths. A compact SG smoothing (window 7, order 2) reduces the noise proxy while preserving broad band shape, SNV removes additive/multiplicative scatter, and PLS with a small latent grid is the standard parsimonious linear comparator for strongly collinear NIR data with limited samples. Comparing against a ridge/raw linear alternative and a nonlinear SVR alternative gives distinct, mechanistically-motivated directions rather than parameter tuning of one family.
uncertainties: Whether smoothing removes signal alongside noise on a 12-wavelength axis.
Whether a nonlinear response exists that PLS/Ridge cannot capture.

expected_improvement.text_expectation: PLS on SG-smoothed SNV spectra selected over the grid by train-CV RMSE, with Cal CV and Val performance reported; the model should generalize to the 12-sample holdout without overfitting.

Quality gates previously graded 'poor' (R2<0.8), so the delivered model is a documented best-effort result, not a production-approved calibration.
hypotheses: SG smoothing + SNV reduces the flagged high-frequency noise and scatter, giving PLS a better-conditioned input than raw spectra.
A small latent grid keeps PLS parsimonious for 36 calibration samples and avoids overfitting.

not_selected_reasons.alt_svr_nonlinear: Never executed; no Cal/Val evidence, and no remaining fits allow testing a nonlinear alternative within budget.

proposal.rationale: The sealed search exhausted its fit budget on the first experiment (16/18 fits, new_fits_allowed=false). Phase=final_selection requires RETAIN of an actual successful historical experiment. The only executed candidate, PLS on SG-smooth+SNV, achieved the strongest available Val performance (R2=0.542, RPD=1.54, near-zero bias) and is the defensible choice; unexecuted alternatives have no evidence.

retained_advantages: Highest observed Val performance among executed candidates (R2=0.542, RPD=1.54, bias=-0.076).
Mechanistically matched preprocessing (SG smoothing + SNV) to the flagged noise and scatter.
Parsimonious PLS (4 components) for a 36-sample calibration.
retained_limitations: Val R2=0.542 and RPD=1.54 fall below default quality gates (R2>=0.8, RPD>=3.0); grade='poor'.
Only 12 wavelengths and 36 samples limit model complexity and reliability.
Val set n=12 makes metrics uncertain.
stop_evidence.search_coverage: One executed experiment using a 5-point PLS latent grid (n_components 1-5) on SG-smooth+SNV; 16 of 18 permitted fits consumed before budget exhaustion. Ridge/SVR/ET and alternative preprocessing were proposed but never executed.
